note: Set B captures several page facts A misses entirely — HSS4X4X1/4, the 3" DIAM STD. PIPE, the 14 GAUGE PLATE deck opening, and the '6" MIN EACH SIDE' reinforcement note — while A repeats the same W6X20, 1'-0" and 1/4" claims multiple times. A also invents two fitted-stiffener dimensions (3" 'total horizontal width' and 2" 'horizontal offset') that are actually foundation-detail dimensions, plus unsupported 'side/top fillet weld' and 'opening height' conditions. B's main faults are a misbound hole diameter (the (4) 3/4" holes belong to the wide-flange/base plate, not the fitted stiffener), W6X20 attributed to the PV attachment rather than the foundation detail, and an invented 'right' overlap condition. Both sets contain duplicates and vague 3/8" claims, but B's coverage of distinct correct facts outweighs its misbindings.
